findings.summary: src/api/homeApi.ts ConsultantHomeData has no awaitingQuestionnaires field and src/api/companiesApi.ts CompanyAttention lacks "aguardando"; both files are outside this lane, so ConsultantHome.tsx, CompanyPage.tsx and CompaniesPage.tsx widen the types locally (intersection type / ListAttention + one cast at listCompanies).

GET /api/companies/:id carries no questionnaire send, so CompanyPage reads "Questionário enviado em {data}" from GET /api/home?mode=consultant awaitingQuestionnaires (filtered by companyId) and updates it from the POST /questionnaire sentAt. A company field (e.g. pendingQuestionnaireSentAt) would avoid the extra home call.

The prototype shows the client message before "Gerar arquivo"; the approved message is built by the server (buildClientMessage) and only arrives in the POST /questionnaire answer, so SendQuestionnaireDialog shows the 3 steps first and the message with "Copiar mensagem" and "Mostrar na pasta" after the file is saved.

Dialogs call only IF-011 (sendQuestionnaire, importAnswers) plus revealSavedFile (IF-002) with the fileId IF-011 returns for "Mostrar na pasta". ImportAnswersDialog refuses files over 1 MB and empty files locally with the same wording as server/validation/questionnaireSchemas.ts (avoids reading a huge file); every other refusal uses the server message + "Nada foi alterado.".

Capability-wide checks were not run in this unit (integration evidence): pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/remoteQuestionnaire.spec.ts tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts (spec owned by another unit / integration), pnpm build, and the Play dev-link walkthrough (send, answer in another browser, import, review and conclude).

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit over src, server, shared, tests: no errors
grep of @/api imports in src/features/questionnaire/*.tsx: only questionnaireApi (IF-011), filesApi.revealSavedFile (fileId from IF-011) and httpClient.isApiError

acceptance_criteria.AC-ra-48: CompanyPage (consultant mode, active company) has "Enviar questionário"; SendQuestionnaireDialog explains 3 steps, POSTs IF-011, shows the saved file name/folder, "Mostrar na pasta", the server message with "Copiar mensagem"; clipboard failure selects the read-only textarea and shows the copy-by-hand hint; the page shows "Questionário enviado em {data}"; ConsultantHome adds the "Questionários aguardando resposta" indicator linking to /empresas?atencao=aguardando.
acceptance_criteria.AC-ra-51: ImportAnswersDialog: file picker (.fitpulse), "Lendo o arquivo…" status, "Rascunho criado" with "Revisar e concluir" -> /diagnostico/{draftId}; CompanyTimeline marks the draft "Respostas do cliente, salvas em {data}" with "Revisar e concluir"; company + timeline + sent notice reload after import.
acceptance_criteria.AC-ra-52: Refusals render in role="alert" with the server's specific message + "Nada foi alterado." and "Escolher outro arquivo".
acceptance_criteria.AC-ra-53: 409 draft_exists opens ConfirmDialog "Substituir o rascunho de {data}?" with consequence and "Substituir rascunho"; Cancel/Esc closes keeping the draft; confirm repeats with replaceDraft: true.

messages.text: Please add awaitingQuestionnaires?: Array<{ companyId; name; sentAt; waitingDays }> to ConsultantHomeData in src/api/homeApi.ts and "aguardando" to CompanyAttention in src/api/companiesApi.ts; then the local widenings in ConsultantHome.tsx (HomeAttention, awaitingQuestionnaires()), CompaniesPage.tsx (ListAttention + cast at listCompanies) and CompanyPage.tsx (AwaitingHomeData) can be dropped.

Selectors for tests/e2e/remoteQuestionnaire.spec.ts: buttons [data-aioson-id=send-questionnaire] / [data-aioson-id=import-answers] (consultant mode only, hidden for archived companies); send modal [data-aioson-id=send-questionnaire-modal], [data-aioson-id=send-generate], [data-aioson-id=send-file-name], [data-aioson-id=send-message] (readonly textarea), [data-aioson-id=send-copy-message], [data-aioson-id=send-show-folder]; page line [data-aioson-id=questionnaire-sent]; import modal [data-aioson-id=import-answers-modal], hidden input [data-aioson-id=import-file-input] (use setInputFiles), [data-aioson-id=import-error] role=alert, [data-aioson-id=import-choose-file] ("Escolher outro arquivo" after a refusal), [data-aioson-id=import-review-draft]; replace confirm [data-aioson-id=import-replace-confirm]; timeline draft row data-source=client-answers with [data-aioson-id=imported-draft].
